title: Open-label Study to Evaluate Metreleptin in Patients With Partial Lipodystrophy
official: A 24-Month, Multi-Centre, Open Label Phase IV Post Authorisation Efficacy Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety and Immunogenicity of Daily Subcutaneous Metreleptin Treatment in Patients With Partial Lipodystrophy
summary: This is an Open Label, Phase IV, Post Authorisation Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety and Immunogenicity of Daily Subcutaneous Metreleptin Treatment in people with Partial Lipodystrophy
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed diagnosis of familial or acquired partial lipodystrophy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Treatment with any Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) within 6 months or 5 times the terminal half-life of the corresponding IMP, whichever is longer, before the screening visit.

Other protocol defined inclusion/exclusion criteria apply
